items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Big Head number two. He worked with George McCullin.

ctx.x: Big Head number two. He worked with George McCullin. Sax I did myself. Shots. I worked with all those folks. The WPA band. One time they had about 80-something other pieces in the band.
We'd like to go and talk to her and her husband both, you know, and everybody over there, you know, when it's convenient with them.
